handback.t:
scorecard: DONE. Committed locally in neural-mesh (explicit paths, not pushed): ingest/scorecard.py, ingest/tests/test_scorecard.py (12 tests, all 81 ingest tests pass), ingest/__main__.py (scorecard subcommand only), results/scorecard.md, results/scorecard.html.

Run: `python -m ingest scorecard [--reset-baseline] [--reps N]`. Full run about 13 s cold, a few seconds incremental (per-file cache in data/lifelong/scorecard_state, keyed by size and mtime). It reuses the ingest code (reader.discover and _is_real_user, extract.parse_ts, util I/O, and the labeler's verdicts in outcomes.jsonl for the re-dispatch and fix-round rates). It adds a light pass over the raw transcripts for the things the reader state doesn't keep: tool names, timing, hooks, compaction.
Outputs: data/lifelong/scorecard.jsonl (one row per session, git-ignored), scorecard_headline.json, results/scorecard.md (baseline table, an "After the cutoff" delta table with session-cluster bootstrap CIs, per-day trend), results/scorecard.html (inline SVG sparklines, no scripts, no external requests; the queen may publish it).
Privacy: aggregate numbers only. A test asserts a planted secret prompt string never reaches the cache, md, html or jsonl.
Baseline cutoff: 2026-10-10T06:47:30Z, stored in data/lifelong/scorecard_baseline.json. It is sticky across runs; --reset-baseline moves it. Turns and dispatches are classed by their own start time, so a long-running session that crosses the cutoff splits correctly. Deltas appear once at least 3 sessions are on each side.

BASELINE (16 sessions, 238 user turns, 493 dispatches; medians / p90):
- tokens per user turn (leader), all: 1.9M / 10.4M. Fresh (in+out+cache write): 20k / 442k.
- tokens per subagent dispatch, all: 6.9M / 29.0M. Fresh: 316k / 975k.
- wall per user turn: 114 s / 1,623 s. Wall per dispatch: 701 s / 3,152 s.
- tool calls per turn: 2 / 17. Per dispatch: 39 / 96.
- searching per dispatch: Read+Grep+Glob only 1 / 4, but search-like Bash (grep/rg/find/cat/ls/head/tail) is 24 / 62. Almost all searching goes through Bash, so a tool-only count would miss it.
- hook wall per turn (Pre/PostToolUse and prompt hooks, max per parallel group): 1.27 s / 21 s. Stop hooks: 0.84 s / 13 s per turn.
- tool_use to tool_result gap, median / p90: Read 38 ms / 2.1 s (the no-hook floor), Edit 3.9 s / 19 s, Write 7.2 s / 28 s, Bash 7.1 s / 43 s. Edit, Write and Bash include permission waits and real work, so this is a ceiling for hook cost, not a pure measure.
- re-dispatch 14.3% of 463 labeled dispatches (15.7% of their tokens); fix-round 2.2% (1.7% of tokens). These are the ingest labeler's heuristic labels, a proxy. The 15% fix-round share from the brief isn't reproduced by the current labels.
- compactions: 7 (0.44 per session). Cache reads are 95.8% of prompt tokens.
- Under-recording: no output-token under-recording detected. 0.0% of messages with content have output_tokens <= 3, and recorded output exceeds a content-length estimate. Real gaps instead: aborted requests leave no usage record, thinking tokens aren't visible in the content, and leader-turn tokens exclude subagents (counted per dispatch). Turn wall time includes permission-prompt waits.

NIGHTLY (I did not edit run_nightly.ps1): insert in llm/scripts/run_nightly.ps1 right after `Write-Log "ingest exit $irc"` and its if/else block, before `# 2) the llm round`. It must run after ingest because it reads outcomes.jsonl. It deliberately does not touch $worst, so it never fails the round:
        # 1b) scorecard (cross-session metrics; reads transcripts + outcomes.jsonl; never fails the round)
        $src = Invoke-Logged $IngestPython @('-m', 'ingest', 'scorecard') $Log
        Write-Log "scorecard exit $src"
After the exit-0 case the ingest `$irc` check isn't needed; placing it after the whole if/else block makes it run even when ingest failed, which is fine.

Notes for the queen: the trainer agent has uncommitted changes in ingest/extract.py and ingest/labeler.py. I did not touch or commit them. If they change the labels, re-run the scorecard (the labels are read live from outcomes.jsonl). results/scorecard.md and .html are committed; they regenerate on every run, so commit them again after later runs if wanted.
